title: Richard Schwank
text:
About
I am a third year PhD student at the chair of Mathematical Statistics at TU Munich. I am very greatful to be supervised by Mathias Drton and funded through relAI.
My research area is non-parametric Statistics and Machine Learning. In particular, I study incomplete observation models and robustness.


Research Interests

Causal identification from cross-sectional data
Generative Diffusion Models
Robust mean estimation
